Type:        DATA_INTERSECTION
Name:        DataIntersection
Category:    transformers
Description: Receives sorted data flows through both input ports, finds data records with the same key values, converts these records to outgoing records according to defined transformation and sends these resulting records to the second output port. Data records contained only in the first or second data flow are sent to the first or third output ports, respectively.
Usage:       When to use: Set operations (intersect, diff, union) between two sorted streams. Produces three output ports covering all three logical regions simultaneously — more efficient than multiple EXT_FILTER passes.
             Constraints: BOTH inputs MUST be pre-sorted on joinKey. Use EXT_HASH_JOIN for equality join where you just want matched records without needing the unmatched subsets separately

Input Ports:
  [0] set A (required)
  [1] set B (required)
Output Ports:
  [0] only in A (optional)
  [1] in A & B (optional)
  [2] only in B (optional)

Properties:
  Always required:
    joinKey

  joinKey: [joinKey] (REQUIRED)  Defines the fields used to join data from multiple input sources.
  transform [attr-cdata]: [transform]  Defines the transformation logic used to convert input records to output records.
  transformURL: [file]  Specifies the path to an external file containing the transformation logic.
  transformClass: [class]  Specifies the Java class that implements the transformation logic.
  charset: [charset]  Defines the character encoding used to encode/decode file content. If not specified, the system will attempt to detect or use the default encoding.
  equalNULL: [bool]  (default: true)  Controls whether NULL values are considered equal when identifying duplicates.
  keyDuplicates: [bool]  (default: true)  Controls whether duplicate key values are allowed in set operations.
  errorActions [attr-cdata]: [errorActions]  Defines the actions to take when errors occur during processing.
  errorLog: [file]  Specifies the file where error information should be logged.
  slaveOverrideKey: [key]  Defines the key fields used for slave override key.

To configure it, call component_get_guide("DATA_INTERSECTION") — full attribute reference with allowed values, defaults, and worked mapping/transform examples this surface view omits. Don't re-run component_get_info on the same type; if the properties above aren't enough, escalate to component_get_guide.
